title: Creativity and innovation
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:32Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-01T08:14:02Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The closest bank point covers entrepreneurs, risk and innovation's effect on competition, but it never teaches the distinction between creativity (coming up with ideas) and innovation (turning an idea into a product, service or process people use), so it is related but not the same idea.

draft.title: Creativity and innovation
card: coming up with a new idea or a new way of seeing a problem. An idea on its own has not changed anything yet.
turning a new idea into a product, service or process that people actually use.
An innovation can be a new product, a new service, or a new process, which is a new way of doing a task inside the business.
Creativity comes first and innovation follows. A business can have many creative ideas and still not innovate if it never puts them to use.
draft.remember: Creativity is the idea. Innovation is the idea put to use.

a.q: Which situation is an example of innovation, not only creativity?
opts: A bakery sells a new sourdough loaf it designed
A baker sketches ideas for new loaf flavours
A baker imagines a loaf shaped like a guitar
A bakery team lists ten ideas for new loaves
a.why: The new loaf has been turned into a product that customers can buy, so the idea has been put to use. The other options only describe ideas, which is creativity and not yet innovation.

b.q: Ravi's cleaning company in Geelong has a team that suggests many new ideas each month, but none have been used. Which statement is correct?
opts: The team is creative but the business has not innovated
The team is innovative because it produces many ideas
The business has innovated because ideas were suggested
The team is neither creative nor innovative
b.why: Producing new ideas is creativity. Innovation needs an idea to be turned into something people use, and none have been. The tempting option confuses having many ideas with putting them to use.
b.clue: Has any idea been put to use?

a.best: A bakery sells a new sourdough loaf it designed

b.best: The team is creative but the business has not innovated
